description: Python script that converts Checkstyle XML reports into Code Climate JSON format, supporting command-line arguments for input/output files, path relativization, and JSON formatting.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for input/output files, formatting options, and path relativization.

methods.name: compute_fingerprint
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash to uniquely identify an issue based on its attributes.

methods.name: _relativize
methods.description: Converts an absolute file path to a relative path based on a base directory.

methods.name: _stream_issues_from_file
methods.description: Streams issues from a Checkstyle XML file using an efficient parse, yielding issue dictionaries.

methods.name: _issues_from_stdin
methods.description: Parses issues from XML data read from stdin.

methods.name: convert_paths
methods.description: Processes multiple input files or stdin to extract issues into a list.

methods.name: write_output
methods.description: Outputs the list of issues as JSON to a specified file, with optional pretty formatting.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that orchestrates argument parsing, issue extraction, and output writing.
